name: exergynet-mcp-server
description: Read-only MCP lookups for the ExergyNet LNES-03 Solana program, plus a local compute-cost estimator. exergynet_open_job is disabled pending a verified Base L2 contract migration.

tools.name: exergynet_get_program_id
tools.description: Returns the LNES-03 Solana Mainnet program ID.

tools.name: exergynet_verify_program
tools.description: Read-only check of whether the LNES-03 program account exists and is executable on the given Solana RPC endpoint.

tools.name: exergynet_get_proof_transaction
tools.description: Returns a reference LNES-03 settlement transaction signature.

tools.name: exergynet_estimate_gate
tools.description: Local arithmetic comparison of an external compute cost estimate against a settlement cost plus risk margin. Makes no network call.

tools.name: exergynet_open_job
tools.description: DISABLED pending safe contract migration (security advisory 2026-08-28). Always returns a fail-closed message. No signing capability exists in this version.
